Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1181
Claimant:
Chris Wallace
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
May 24, 2023
Claimant reported a side impact at a signalized intersection and provided a consistent account of how the other
vehicle entered the junction. Police and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the
time, and the driver is named on the policy.
June 28, 2023
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement both match the described impact, and the damage to the
claimant's vehicle lines up with a side strike. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the file
suggetss the damage predates the start of coverage.
July 25, 2023
Claimant has reported a wrist fracture, but it is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash. Medical records
are requested to confirm the diagnosis and the mechanism of injury.
August 18, 2023
Treatment so far has followed a usual course, with the claimant attending follow-up visits that became less frequent
as the wrist improved. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the information gathered to date.
November 2, 2023
Each time the claimant has been contacted, the account of the collision has stayed the same in its key details. The
claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been answering questions directly.
November 30, 2023
Current status: liability and vehicle damage appear established, while the causation question for the wrist injury
remains open pending the medical records. Next step is to review the records and schedule a follow-up with the
claimant.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
